chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, Allah the Exalted did not grant Satan authority over those who have faith.
But upon those who take him as their guardian.

key_terms.يَتَوَلَّوْنَهُمْ: Those who take him as guardian/ally

ai.seo_question: Who does Satan have authority over according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifying that Satan's authority is not absolute over all believers but specifically over those who make him their ally, a distinction rooted in the interpretation of Surah Al-Imran. This hadith underscores the Shia doctrine of *Ismah* (infallibility) and *Hifz* (divine protection), asserting that true believers are preserved from Satan's dominion through their conscious allegiance to God and the Ahl al-Bayt.
